run_refmanual_generator: run the refmanual script to generate Boost.MPL documentation from RST source files into a build directory
build_section_header: build a reStructuredText section header with underline and hidden label target from a section path string
create_section_intro: create an intro RST filename from a section path by joining parts with hyphens
include_page_with_ref: include an RST page into output and write a substitution reference for its name
write_index_file: write a sorted bulleted index file from a list of names to a given filename
